caption: My book Safe Rule Changes in Telemetry Systems is on Amazon. Search "Safe Rule Changes in Telemetry Systems Jesús Cabrera".

slides.say: You tweak a single telemetry rule, and suddenly alerts go silent or start firing everywhere. Sound familiar?

slides.screen: Rules are code. Treat them that way.
slides.say: Rules in telemetry systems decide what gets flagged. Changing them deserves the same care as shipping code.
I wrote a book on making rule changes in telemetry systems safely, for engineers who run these systems every day.
It's on Amazon: Safe Rule Changes in Telemetry Systems. Follow for more.
